verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents an official CLI built for AI agents and scripts. It gives full workspace access, covers the Journeys UI API and CDP Pipelines API through a single `cio api` command, returns structured JSON, is self-describing via `cio schema`, and ships an install skill that teaches AI assistants to drive it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI beyond first-party docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Customer.io CLI is a command-line tool that gives AI agents and scripts full access to your Customer.io workspaces.
It covers the Journeys UI API and CDP Data Pipelines API through a single `cio api` command—no per-endpoint code, no SDK boilerplate.
Every command returns structured JSON, every endpoint is self-describing via `cio schema`
install our skill—a set of instructions that teaches your AI assistant how to drive the CLI.
